summary: Skier injured in the 'Suicide Chutes' area of Bear Creek near Telluride; companions began packaging and extrication before help arrived; San Miguel County SO SAR responded just before noon, transported the patient by snowmobile to the Bear Creek Trailhead, and transferred care to Telluride Fire EMTs for transport to Telluride Medical Center
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue; Telluride Fire Department EMS
notes: Injury mechanism not stated in the sheriff release
